topics.concept: A document Q&A assistant answers natural-language questions using only the text of a supplied document, reducing hallucinations by grounding every answer in retrieved passages. The pipeline splits the document into chunks, finds the chunks most relevant to the question, and composes an answer with source references. Confidence drops gracefully when the document contains no relevant information.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded synthetic policy manuals and FAQ documents, asks scripted questions, and verifies answers cite the correct chunk.

key_params.top_k: number of chunks retrieved per question

topics.name: Document Q&A Assistant
topics.real_world_use: Powers help-center bots and internal knowledge assistants that answer from company documentation.

topics.concept: An LLM-powered code reviewer reads a diff and flags bugs, style issues, and security smells with explanations and suggested fixes. Unlike lint rules, it reasons about intent, spotting logic errors like off-by-one mistakes or unchecked return values. The simulation scores findings against a seeded set of known defects.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded code snippets with planted bugs (null dereferences, injection flaws), runs the reviewer, and measures precision and recall.

key_params.max_findings: cap on reported issues per diff

topics.name: LLM-Powered Code Review
topics.real_world_use: Used in CI pipelines to give developers instant feedback before human review.

topics.concept: Structured output parsing forces model responses into a machine-readable schema such as JSON with required fields and types. The parser validates the response, retries with a repair prompt on failure, and falls back to a safe default. This turns free-text generation into a reliable component of data pipelines.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded prompts with occasional malformed outputs, parses them against schemas, and reports retry and fallback rates.

key_params.schema_fields: required fields in the output schema
key_params.strict_mode: reject extra fields or allow them

topics.name: Structured Output Parsing
topics.real_world_use: Extracting invoices, forms, and API payloads from unstructured text in automation workflows.

topics.concept: A summarization engine compresses long text into a short version that preserves the key facts, using extractive selection or abstractive rewriting. Length targets and focus keywords steer the output toward what the reader needs. Evaluation compares the summary against reference key points for coverage.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded long-form articles with known key points and checks that summaries recover them.
topics.name: Text Summarization Engine
topics.real_world_use: News digests, executive briefings, and meeting recap tools rely on automatic summarization.

topics.concept: Entity extraction identifies people, organizations, dates, amounts, and other typed spans inside free text. The pipeline tokenizes input, labels candidate spans, and normalizes values such as dates into ISO format. A confusion-matrix evaluation against labeled seeds shows where the extractor confuses similar entity types.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded sentences with annotated entities and measures precision and recall per entity type.

key_params.entity_types: list of entity categories to extract
key_params.min_confidence: confidence threshold for keeping a span

topics.name: Entity Extraction Pipeline
topics.real_world_use: Contract analysis, resume parsing, and news monitoring extract structured facts from text.

topics.concept: Zero-shot classification assigns labels to text without any training examples, using only a description of each category. The model scores how well the text fits each label description and picks the best match. This makes it practical for new taxonomies where labeled data does not exist yet.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded texts across synthetic categories and checks classification accuracy against the known labels.

key_params.multi_label: allow more than one label per text
key_params.threshold: minimum score to assign a label

topics.name: Zero-Shot Text Classification
topics.real_world_use: Routing support tickets and tagging content when no labeled training set is available.

topics.concept: A translation hub converts text between languages while preserving tone and domain terminology through glossary hints. It detects the source language automatically and handles mixed-language input gracefully. Quality checks flag untranslated segments and terminology drift against the glossary.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded bilingual phrase pairs with glossary terms and verifies terminology preservation.
topics.name: Language Translation Hub
topics.real_world_use: Localizing product copy and translating customer messages in global support teams.

topics.concept: Sentiment analysis classifies text as positive, negative, or neutral and scores intensity, which powers brand monitoring and feedback triage. The simulation adds aspect-level analysis, attributing sentiment to specific product features mentioned in a review. Sarcasm and negation handling are the classic accuracy pitfalls.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded reviews with known sentiment per aspect and measures accuracy and calibration.

key_params.threshold: confidence needed to report a label

topics.name: Sentiment Analysis API Sim
topics.real_world_use: Product teams mine app-store reviews and social mentions for feature-level sentiment.

topics.concept: A meeting-notes summarizer turns a raw transcript into decisions, action items, and open questions with owner names attached. Speaker diarization labels who said what, so action items can be assigned to the right person. The output follows a fixed template so every meeting produces comparable notes.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded meeting transcripts with planted decisions and action items and checks extraction completeness.
topics.name: Meeting Notes Summarizer
topics.real_world_use: Meeting assistants that auto-generate notes and follow-ups after calls.

topics.concept: An email drafting assistant turns a few bullet points into a complete, tone-appropriate message. Tone presets such as formal, friendly, or firm adjust word choice and structure. The tool keeps drafts short by default and always lets the user edit before anything is sent.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded bullet-point briefs and drafts, then checks tone classification and length compliance.

key_params.include_subject: whether to generate a subject line

topics.name: Email Drafting Assistant
topics.real_world_use: Sales and support teams draft outreach and replies faster with tone-controlled generation.

topics.concept: A semantic router classifies an incoming request by meaning and forwards it to the right handler: a refund flow, a technical specialist, or a general assistant. Instead of keyword rules, it embeds the request and compares it against embedded descriptions of each route. A confidence threshold sends ambiguous requests to a safe default handler.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded requests per route plus ambiguous ones, and measures routing accuracy and fallback rate.

key_params.threshold: minimum similarity to accept a route

topics.name: Semantic Router for Requests
topics.real_world_use: Chat platforms route user messages to specialized bots or human queues by intent.

topics.concept: Small language models trade raw capability for speed, low cost, and on-device deployment. The lab benchmarks compact models against larger ones on classification, extraction, and summarization tasks to find where small is good enough. Quantization and distillation concepts show how models shrink without losing much accuracy.
topics.data_idea: Simulates seeded accuracy and latency numbers across model sizes and plots the cost-quality frontier.
topics.name: Small Language Model Lab
topics.real_world_use: On-device assistants and high-volume classification use small models to control cost and latency.

topics.concept: Caching stores model responses keyed by a hash of the prompt, so repeated or near-duplicate requests skip the expensive generation call. Semantic caching extends this by matching prompts whose embeddings are close enough to reuse an answer. Cache hit rate, staleness policy, and invalidation rules determine the savings.
topics.data_idea: Simulates seeded request streams with duplicates and near-duplicates and reports hit rate and estimated cost saved.
topics.name: LLM Response Caching
topics.real_world_use: High-traffic AI features cache common queries to cut latency and inference bills.

topics.concept: A resume bullet rewriter tightens weak experience bullets using the action-verb plus quantified-result formula while keeping every fact the user supplied. It flags invented metrics and asks for real numbers instead of guessing. A before-and-after score estimates keyword match against a target job description.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded weak bullets and verifies rewrites keep original facts while adding structure.
topics.name: Resume Bullet Rewriter
topics.real_world_use: Career tools help applicants sharpen bullets without fabricating experience.

topics.concept: An FAQ chat widget answers customer questions from a curated FAQ set, retrieving the best-matching entry and presenting it conversationally. When no FAQ matches confidently, it escalates to a human instead of guessing. Analytics track which questions miss so the FAQ set can grow.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded FAQs and paraphrased user questions, then measures match accuracy and escalation rate.
topics.name: FAQ Chat Widget
topics.real_world_use: Website support widgets deflect common questions before they reach agents.

topics.concept: A moderation filter scores user-generated text for toxicity, spam, and policy violations before it goes live. Multi-category scoring with per-category thresholds balances false positives against missed violations. Flagged items queue for human review with the offending spans highlighted.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded benign and violating texts and measures precision, recall, and review-queue load.
topics.name: Content Moderation Filter
topics.real_world_use: Forums and marketplaces screen posts and listings automatically before publication.

topics.concept: A product description writer turns a spec sheet of features into persuasive, SEO-friendly copy in a brand voice. Constraint inputs like word count, reading level, and banned phrases keep output consistent across a catalog. A/B test hooks compare variants on click-through in simulation.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded product specs and checks descriptions for keyword inclusion and length compliance.
topics.name: Product Description Writer
topics.real_world_use: E-commerce teams generate catalog copy at scale with consistent voice.

topics.concept: A SQL generator converts plain-English questions into queries against a known schema, grounding table and column names to avoid hallucinating fields. Generated SQL is validated by parsing and, in simulation, executed against a seeded database to check the result set. Ambiguous requests trigger a clarifying question instead of a guess.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded schemas and natural-language questions with expected result sets, then checks query correctness.

key_params.validate_execution: whether to run the query in simulation

topics.name: SQL Query Generator
topics.real_world_use: Analytics tools let non-technical users query data with natural language.

topics.concept: A regex builder translates plain-English descriptions into regular expressions and explains what each part matches. Every generated pattern is tested against seeded positive and negative examples before being accepted. The explainer mode teaches the pattern piece by piece, which doubles as a learning tool.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded match and non-match strings and verifies generated patterns classify them correctly.
topics.name: Regex Pattern Builder
topics.real_world_use: Developers prototype validation patterns and log parsers from descriptions.

topics.concept: A labeling assistant pre-labels items so human annotators only confirm or correct, which multiplies labeling throughput. It surfaces low-confidence items first under an active-learning policy and tracks inter-annotator agreement to catch guideline drift. Disagreement cases get escalated to a tie-break review.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded items with hidden true labels and simulated annotator noise, then measures throughput and accuracy.
topics.name: Data Labeling Assistant
topics.real_world_use: ML teams build training datasets faster with model-assisted pre-labeling.

topics.concept: Ticket triage reads an incoming support request, assigns priority and category, and routes it to the right queue with a suggested first response. Priority scoring weighs urgency signals like outage language against customer tier. Misrouted tickets are the key metric, tracked per category in the simulation.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded tickets with known correct queues and measures routing accuracy and SLA risk.
topics.name: Support Ticket Triage
topics.real_world_use: Support platforms auto-route tickets so urgent issues reach the right team fast.

topics.concept: A release-notes writer converts raw commit messages and pull-request titles into grouped, user-facing notes by change type: features, fixes, and breaking changes. Breaking changes are detected from keywords and flagged prominently. The output follows a changelog template with version headers.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded commit histories with known breaking changes and checks grouping and flag accuracy.
topics.name: Release Notes Writer
topics.real_world_use: Engineering teams publish readable release notes from raw development history.

topics.concept: A documentation writer reads functions and modules and produces docstrings describing parameters, return values, and edge cases. It cross-checks the docs against the actual signature so parameter names never drift. Coverage reporting shows which public functions still lack documentation.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded functions with signatures and verifies docstrings name the real parameters.
topics.name: Code Documentation Writer
topics.real_world_use: Teams backfill API docs and keep docstrings in sync with code changes.

topics.concept: An action-item extractor scans meeting transcripts for commitments, assigns each an owner and a due date, and deduplicates repeated mentions of the same task. Vague commitments are flagged for clarification rather than silently dropped. The result feeds directly into a task tracker format.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded transcripts with planted commitments and checks extraction precision and recall.

key_params.owner_resolution: how speaker names map to owners

topics.name: Action Item Extractor
topics.real_world_use: Productivity tools turn meeting talk into tracked tasks automatically.

topics.concept: A quiz generator builds multiple-choice questions from study material, writing one correct answer and plausible distractors that target common misconceptions. Difficulty calibration tags each question, and a validation pass rejects questions where distractors are accidentally correct. Answer keys include explanations.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded study passages and validates that each question has exactly one correct option.
topics.name: Quiz Question Generator
topics.real_world_use: Ed-tech platforms auto-generate practice quizzes from course content.

topics.concept: A paraphrase detector decides whether two texts say the same thing despite different wording, using embedding similarity plus an entailment check. Threshold tuning trades false alarms against missed copies. The tool highlights aligned phrases so a human can judge borderline cases quickly.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded paraphrase and non-paraphrase pairs and measures accuracy across thresholds.
topics.name: Paraphrase Detector
topics.real_world_use: Plagiarism checkers and duplicate-content detectors compare text at scale.

topics.concept: A tone rewriter adjusts a message toward a target tone, such as more diplomatic or more assertive, while preserving the factual content. A content-preservation check compares key facts before and after the rewrite to catch drift. An evaluation harness scores tone shift versus meaning preservation across a test set.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded messages with fact lists and checks that rewrites keep all facts while shifting tone.
topics.name: Tone Rewriter
topics.real_world_use: Customer communication tools soften or sharpen messages without changing their meaning.

topics.concept: A clause finder locates specific provisions such as termination, indemnity, or renewal terms inside long contracts and extracts them with surrounding context. Clause-type descriptions act as semantic queries over chunked contract text. Risk flags highlight unusual language compared to standard templates.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded contracts with planted clauses and measures retrieval recall per clause type.
topics.name: Contract Clause Finder
topics.real_world_use: Legal teams review vendor agreements faster by jumping straight to key clauses.

topics.concept: An agenda builder converts a meeting goal and attendee list into a timed agenda with discussion topics, owners, and prep materials. Time budgeting allocates minutes per topic and flags overruns before the meeting starts. Recurring-meeting mode carries forward unresolved items from the last agenda.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded meeting goals and checks agendas for time-budget consistency and topic coverage.
topics.name: Meeting Agenda Builder
topics.real_world_use: Teams standardize meeting prep so discussions start focused and end on time.

topics.concept: A news digest writer clusters incoming articles by story, picks the representative angle per cluster, and writes a brief with key developments and source links. Deduplication keeps the same story from appearing twice under different headlines. Topic filters let readers build a personalized briefing.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded article streams with known story clusters and checks dedup and coverage.
topics.name: News Digest Writer
topics.real_world_use: Newsletter products and executive briefings condense the daily news into skimmable digests.
